subject: Post-call next steps: Arcana Retail evaluation & owner assignments
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Lindsey Park <lindsey.park@arcanaretail.com>, Tom Wu <tom.wu@arcanaretail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed narrow POC scope

Hi Lindsey / Tom —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

What we heard from Arcana
- Goal: Use Redwood inference to power in-store conversational assistant for product lookup and inventory answers during peak hours. Primary KPI is >70% first-response accuracy for SKU/availability queries and median latency < 250ms for short queries.
- Scope for pilot: 5 stores, 2k unique SKUs, daytime traffic profile (peak concurrency ~30 reqs/s).
- Success threshold: accuracy + latency above, plus no PII leakage to any external logs.

Proposed Redwood POC plan (narrowed to 3 weeks)
1) Week 0 (this week): finalize mutual action plan and data access. Owner: Lindsey (Arcana) + Monica (Redwood)
2) Week 1: Model selection & baseline run on Arcana sample traffic. Owner: Marissa
3) Week 2: Performance tuning (batching/kv cache) + latency SLO verification. Owner: Sean
4) Week 3: QA & acceptance test against 500 held-out queries. Acceptance sign-off: Tom (Arcana)

Attachments: I attached a short success-criteria workbook and a one-page mutual action plan (MAP). Please review — I highlighted fields we need to confirm by EOD Thursday so we can start baseline runs early next week.

Immediate asks
- Lindsey: confirm you can share a redacted sample of 2k SKU titles + inventory signals (S3 link or secure share) by Thursday EOD.
- Tom: confirm the acceptance tester and sign-off contact (name + email).
- Monica & Marissa: confirm resource availability for Week 1/2 windows.

If that aligns I’ll update the MAP with timelines and drop the baseline onboarding checklist into the shared Drive.

Thanks,
Sean
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Thanks Sean — this looks good and appreciated the clear breakdown. Quick clarifications: 

- We can provide a redacted S3 export of SKU titles, category, and a simple in-store availability flag by Thursday EOD. IT will remove customer identifiers.
- Acceptance tester: Tom (tom.wu@arcanaretail.com) — I’ll have him pull 500 holdout queries from transaction logs and provide the expected answers.
- One ask: can Redwood run an initial baseline inference against a 1000-query sample first, then we ramp the remaining 1000? That helps us validate the extraction before shipping the full corpus.

Also: security questionnaire items on logging retention — Monica, can you confirm Redwood’s default retention window for token logs in hosted trials and the options for shorter retention? We need that for our security folks.

I’ll upload the S3 link to the Drive link you shared when ready.

Best,
Lindsey Park

Lindsey — thanks for the fast follow. Quick answers from Redwood infra/security side: 

- Default hosted trial token/log retention: 30 days. We can configure a 7-day retention window for trials with an NDA and signed data handling addendum; for on-prem/private we can set retention to customer policy.
- For the baseline run cadence: we can do the 1k initial sample first, validate results, then run the remaining 1k. That works fine.

Resource commitments:
- Marissa: will own the baseline runs and initial eval (Week 1).
- I’ll coordinate the onboarding checklist and S3 ingestion (Week 0 -> Week 1 transition).

I’ll also upload a short security note and the retention policy excerpt to the Drive folder for your security team.
